actions.action: Make presets optional, inspectable starting points
actions.mechanism: Expose each preset’s permission changes while preserving custom combinations and edits rather than silently reapplying defaults.
actions.implementation: Replace the undocumented preset with a named, expandable permission list. Require explicit Apply; retain all 18 editable toggles and label deviations Custom.
actions.check: Load representative custom combinations, change unrelated invite fields, and verify every permission remains unchanged. Previewing a preset must not modify selections.
actions.risk: Preset descriptions can drift; generate their permission lists from actual configuration.

actions.action: Require separate publishing and billing selections
actions.mechanism: Sensitive privileges need deliberate owner selection, including when templates or copied configurations would otherwise introduce them.
actions.implementation: Never preselect publishing or billing for a new invite. Flag sensitive effective privileges and require separate, initially unchecked owner selections before sending.
actions.check: Apply a publishing-enabled template and copy a billing-enabled role. Neither invite may send with those privileges without explicit owner selection.
actions.risk: Indirect grants need actionable explanations; acknowledgment alone must not change permissions.

actions.action: Check effective access against the intended work
actions.mechanism: An independent task expectation detects mismatches without guessing which permission configuration the owner intended.
actions.implementation: Show calculated effective access before sending. Capture review-drafts and no-publishing expectations; block mismatches until permissions or explicit expectations change. Treat calculation failures as unresolved.
actions.check: Inject an indirect publishing grant into a reviewer configuration. Confirm preflight identifies publishing and prevents sending; also test an unavailable calculation.
actions.risk: Expectations are owner-provided checks, not proof that every unintended privilege is excluded.

actions.action: Organize permissions without hiding custom controls
actions.mechanism: Task-based grouping reduces scanning while native controls and predictable focus preserve complete keyboard access.
actions.implementation: Group all 18 toggles into labeled disclosure sections; provide Expand all, visible focus, and keyboard-operable previews. Link validation messages to affected controls.
actions.check: Using only the keyboard, reproduce a custom combination, inspect effective access, correct a privilege warning, and send. Verify collapsed controls retain their values.
actions.risk: Collapsed sections can conceal grants; show enabled counts and sensitive-access warnings in headings.
